# BreathART Photography Studio

> BreathART Photography Studio is a premium photography and videography studio in the United Arab Emirates, with outlets in Dubai (Al Qusais) and Abu Dhabi and at-home sessions across all seven emirates. It is best known for newborn and maternity photography, and also offers family, cake smash, wedding, corporate, event, real estate and commercial photography, videography, event management and photo printing. BreathART Photography is part of the BreathART Group.

## Key facts

- Name: BreathART Photography Studio (also written BreathArt Studio, BreathART Photography)
- Website: https://www.breathartstudio.com
- Specialty: newborn photography, maternity photography, family and cake smash photography
- Locations: Dubai studio at 12 22A Street, Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE; outlet in Abu Dhabi
- Home service: photographers travel to clients' homes anywhere in the UAE — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah
- Experience: photographing families in the UAE for more than 12 years
- Team: 100+ creators (photographers, videographers, editors and stylists) across the BreathART Group
- Female (lady) photographer available on request
- Google rating: 4.7 out of 5
- Pricing: premium quality at affordable prices; newborn packages from AED 499 all-inclusive, with the home session in Dubai included and no hidden extras (see https://www.breathartstudio.com/offers)
- Payment: cash, card, Tabby and Tamara
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 52 640 0679, +971 52 215 0837
- Email: info@breathartstudio.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/breathart.photography and https://www.instagram.com/newborn_photography_breathart

## Newborn photography

BreathART is a specialist newborn photography studio in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Sessions are safe and baby-led: babies are always supported, advanced poses are created as composites, rooms are kept warm, and wraps and props are cleaned between sessions. The recommended age is 5–14 days after birth. Sessions take two to three hours and can be done in the studio or at the family's home anywhere in the UAE.

### Newborn photography packages (AED)

- Basic — AED 499 all-inclusive: 1–2 hour session in our studio or at your home (home session in Dubai included, no travel fee), 20 retouched images, 50+ soft-edited images, 1 premium theme, parents included (up to 5 family members), candid shots, private online gallery
- Silver Nest — AED 699 (most popular): 2–3 hour session, 30 retouched images, 100+ unedited images, 1–2 premium themes, parents & siblings, candid close-ups, 1 reel video, digital album, passport-size photo
- Golden Nest — AED 999: 3–4 hour session, 40 retouched images, 80–120 soft-edited images, 3–4 premium themes, full family coverage, signature poses, free cinematic highlight video, digital album, 3 premium frames, passport-size photo
- Diamond Nest — AED 1,800: unlimited session time, 70 retouched images, 4–5 premium themes, full family coverage, creative concept shots, free 2-minute cinematic video, digital + premium printed album, 3 premium frames, passport-size photo
- Every newborn package includes the option of an at-home session in Dubai at no extra cost; a lady photographer is available on request
- Payment: card, cash, Tabby and Tamara

Group companies include BreathART Photography, Forventures (AI consultancy), TradeLicenceDXB (https://tradelicencedxb.com, business setup) and BICT (AI institute in India, https://www.breathartinstitute.in).
